summary: Gulf Resources filed a Form 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing a delay in filing its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, due to accounting adjustments required in response to SEC comments on its 2024 Form 10-K. No transaction, tender offer, restructure, or special-situation event is announced. The filing is a routine current report on a filing delay. It does not fall into any special-situations category.
